besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses (julle stry / julle speel).
besluite.rede: Two full clauses with their own subject and verb take the AWS comma; the meaning is unchanged.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses (afknouery lyk / jy kan herken).
besluite.rede: Two full clauses take the AWS comma; nothing else changes.

besluite.fout: 'praat en die saak uitmaak' is loose and slightly redundant.
besluite.rede: 'Die saak uitpraat' is the natural Afrikaans idiom for settling a quarrel by talking, with the same people and the same meaning.

besluite.fout: Bare 'name ... gesê' does not clearly mean insulting names.
besluite.rede: 'Skelname' says plainly what is meant without adding a new fact.
'Jou goed vat' is already natural and clear in this list; 'afvat' is a lateral move.

besluite.fout: 'Hierdie dinge' opens the block pointing back to nothing; the things only follow.
besluite.rede: 'Die volgende dinge' gives the correct forward reference, and the later 'Hierdie dinge help' still points back correctly.

besluite.fout: 'Loop ... by die stil plekke' is slightly unclear about where the walking happens.
besluite.rede: The swap from 'by' to 'deur' changes the place relation inside a safety instruction, so the writer must decide the wording.

besluite.fout: 'keer nie altyd die afknouery nie' follows English order; a definite object normally precedes 'nie altyd'.
besluite.rede: The proposed order is more natural Afrikaans and the qualifier 'nie altyd' stays intact.

besluite.fout: The next sentence says 'Daardie lys' though no list has been introduced.
besluite.rede: 'In 'n lys' only names what the following sentences already assume, so the instruction itself is unchanged.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses (die grootmens help / hy glo).
besluite.rede: Two full clauses take the AWS comma; the meaning is unchanged.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses (jy mag sê / dit bly).
besluite.rede: The comma is required by the AWS and the protected wording 'dit bly nooit jou skuld nie' is left intact.

besluite.fout: The trailing afterthought 'of 'n afrigter by die sportveld' after a comma reads like an English add-on.
besluite.rede: One list of three reads cleaner, with the same three people and no change to who the child may ask.

besluite.fout: 'n hulplyn in ons land vir kinders' splits 'hulplyn vir kinders' awkwardly.
besluite.rede: The proposed order is the natural one and says the same thing.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en', and 'dit werk' is vague and repeated in the next sentence.
besluite.rede: The proposal rebuilds the sentence carrying the Childline number and when to call, which is safety wording the writer owns.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses, and 'werk vanaf alle netwerke' copies English 'works from all networks'.
besluite.rede: The comma is required and 'werk op alle netwerke' is the natural preposition with the same meaning: the call works whichever network you use.

besluite.fout: 'Aan die ander kant' alone can be read as the idiom 'on the other hand'.
besluite.rede: 'Van die lyn' removes the stumble and adds no new fact.

besluite.fout: 'oor en oor doelbewus' stacks two adverbs, and 'doelbewus' differs from the marker word 'aspris' in the agreed afknouery definition.
besluite.rede: This rewords a glossary definition beyond a spelling or grammar fix, so only the writer may change it.
